newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Sam Yang says buys 15,000 tonnes of U.S. soybean.
newsitem.headline: Sam Yang says buys 15,000 tonnes of U.S. soybean.

text.p: South Korea's Sam Yang Foods Co Ltd on Friday said it had bought 15,000 tonnes of U.S. No.2 soybean from Tomen of Japan at basis over March futures on the Chicago Board of Trade.
A Sam Yang official said the purchase of the soybean from Japanese trading house Tomen Corp was through private negotiation.
Shipment was slated for March 1-20 from the U.S. Gulf to South Korea's western port of Inchon.
The official said the purchase was equivalent to nearly $300 per tonne FOB.
